propositions: The enrich drain holds its advisory lock across no-timeout LLM calls (437s and 131s observed), blocking concurrent drain children with lock-held skip, creating a single-flight bottleneck with a ~1,046-entry backlog.

Restructure drain() into three phases—collect (under lock, with concurrency guard capped at 3 drainers), enrich (no lock held), and finalize (revalidate snapshot, re-enqueue stale entries with soak 0)—to release the lock before LLM calls and enable concurrent drainers.
The effective batch cap must be lease-derived (max(1, lease_ttl_s / 40) = ~22 at default 15-min lease) to prevent a configured batch from outrunning its lease mid-run and causing crash blast radius.
Stale-at-writeback entries (ticket edited between claim and finalize) must skip digest emit, re-enqueue with soak 0, and be counted as stale_skipped to ensure fresh enrichment on retry.

Concurrent drainers must be pinned by instrumented tests that verify (1) lock released during every LLM call, (2) zero duplicate calls on N tickets with concurrent drains, and (3) lease-expiry recovery by subsequent drains.
